Regal AI Pro Smart Watch

Features of Product

1.19" AMOLED Display with 360×360 Resolution A 1.19-inch AMOLED screen at 360×360p renders text, watch faces, and workout stats in deep contrast and rich color. Choose from 8 different menu view styles, adjust brightness on the fly, switch themes, or leave the always-on display running so the time is there the moment you glance down.

Built-in ChatGPT & Voice Assistant The Regal AI Pro puts AI on your wrist. ChatGPT support plus voice assistant access means you can ask questions, get answers, and handle quick tasks without reaching for your phone.

Bluetooth 5.3 Calling Powered by the JL7013A6 chipset with Bluetooth 5.3 and a 10-meter range, the built-in speaker and microphone let you take calls straight from your wrist. Sync your contact book, browse call records, and get incoming call, message, and app notifications the moment they land.

Full Health & Wellness Tracking An HRS3600 sensor drives 24-hour heart rate monitoring alongside blood pressure, SpO2, and blood oxygen tracking. Sleep monitoring breaks down your night, stress tracking flags the tense days, and breathing training helps you reset. A DA267 accelerometer handles step counting and calorie tracking, and a dedicated menstrual cycle tracker rounds out the female health suite.

100+ Sports Modes Nine sports modes are built into the watch, with 100+ more available through the Zero Health app, covering running, cycling, indoor training, and far beyond. A sedentary reminder nudges you when you've been still too long, and a water reminder keeps you hydrated through the day.

5-Day Battery, 15-Day Standby A 260mAh polymer battery delivers 3-5 days of everyday use and up to 15 days on standby, recharging in about 2.5 hours through the included USB magnetic cable. Just snap it on, no fiddling with ports.

IP68 Water Resistance & AiR Silicon Build An IP68 rating means rain, sweat, and hand-washing splashes are no problem. The AiR Silicon body keeps the whole watch at just 59.2g with a 44.52mm bezel dial and a 155.6×20mm strap that stays comfortable from morning to night.

100+ Watch Faces, Plus Your Own Nine watch faces come preloaded, 100+ more wait in the Zero Health app, and DIY watch face support lets you set your own photo as the dial.

Everything Else You Reach For Daily A functional rotating crown makes navigation quick, and the essentials are all onboard: camera remote, music playback and control, weather updates, alarms, flashlight, calculator, stopwatch and countdown, theater/DND mode, split screen, find my phone, find my device, gesture-to-wake, and three built-in games (Young Bird, Sudoku, and Hampster). Firmware stays current through OTA updates.

entry.title: Arcade Nitro Zbuds
entry.summary:
Vendor: ZeroLifestyle.co
Type: Earbuds
Price: 6499.00

Arcade Nitro Zbuds

Features of Product

10mm Drivers for Full, Punchy Sound A 10mm audible unit in each earbud pushes deep low end and clear highs across a full 20Hz to 20KHz range. With 16Ω impedance and 93dB sensitivity, the Arcade Nitro Zbuds run loud and clean off any phone or tablet, and SBC and AAC decoding keeps the signal faithful from track to ear.

FF ANC with Transparency Mode Feed-forward Active Noise Cancellation quiets engine hum, office chatter, and crowd noise so your audio stays front and centre. One long touch cycles you through Transparency, ANC, and Normal, so you can let the outside world back in for an announcement or a quick conversation without taking an earbud out.

ENC Noise Reduction for Calls Silicon microphones with ENC call noise reduction lock onto your voice and hold back the background, so the person on the other end hears you instead of the street behind you.

15 Hours of Total Playtime A 40mA battery in each earbud gives you 5 hours of listening per charge, and the 450mA charging case brings that up to 15 hours of total playtime. Standby runs to 70 hours, and a full recharge over Type-C takes about 2 hours. A charging indicator shows you where you stand at a glance.

IPX4 Water Resistance An IPX4 rating handles sweat, splashes, and light rain, so gym sessions, runs, and unexpected weather are not a problem.

Bluetooth 5.4 with Jieli 7006F8 Built on the Jieli 7006F8 platform, Bluetooth 5.4 holds a stable connection out to 10 meters. Quick Pairing gets you connected fast, master-slave switching lets either earbud run solo when you only need one in, and Siri or Google Assistant is a long touch away.

Multi-Functional Touch Button An MFB touch control on each earbud handles the whole set: play and pause, next and last track, volume up and down, answering, rejecting, and ending calls, voice assistant, and switching between ANC, Transparency, and Normal. Your phone can stay in your pocket.

Compact Case, Three Colors The 58.02 x 58.02 x 28.83mm case is small enough to vanish into a pocket, and the whole set weighs just 48g. Available in Black, White, and Green.
